content.summary: Backend software engineer with 5 years of experience building reliable Go and TypeScript services for payments, logistics, and data products. Experienced with PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and API observability for distributed teams.

experience.title: Backend Software Engineer
bullets: Built Go payment APIs processing 1.2 million monthly requests, maintaining 99.95% availability across 3 regions.
Reduced PostgreSQL query latency by 46% through index redesign and query-plan profiling for a 90 GB database.
Implemented OpenTelemetry tracing for 14 services, decreasing mean incident diagnosis time by 35%.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Developed TypeScript and Node.js integrations for 9 SME clients, increasing successful order synchronization to 98.7%.
Designed CI pipelines that reduced average release time from 90 minutes to 18 minutes for 6 applications.
